description: The passage does not describe {name}: nothing of the kind is financed, built, installed, required or assigned by this project.

{name} is mentioned only as background or context, not as something this project does: a hazard, a vulnerability or the country's situation; a lesson from past projects or disasters; a general aim or claim that something will be resilient, green, sustainable, low-carbon, climate-smart or meet resilience standards, without naming what is done; an upstream diagnostic such as a Country Climate and Development Report; the World Bank's own climate and disaster risk screening, Paris Alignment assessment or climate co-benefit calculation; a description of systems or practices that already exist; a results-framework indicator, target or result to be measured ("number of ...", "share of ..."); an assumption in the economic or financial analysis; another World Bank project's or another donor's activities; an example given to illustrate a benefit, a cost or a possible use; a claim that the project's investments will help, enable, be leveraged for or can be used for {name} without this project doing it; or work by another agency that this project neither finances nor requires. Training staff to do it later is 1. A heading, lead-in or summary that names an area of support without saying what is done for {name} ("support to legal and regulatory environments", "to strengthen data governance:") is 1, and so is general technical assistance, capacity building or institutional strengthening that does not name {name}.

This project intends or plans {name}, or makes it conditional, subject to a later study, design or recommendation. An activity the sentence itself words as possible or optional ("may include", "could", "would", "possibly", "where feasible", "as needed", "if needed") is 2, not 3. Measures offered as possibilities ("for example, could") are 2, and so are "will consider", "when applicable", "will seek to" and "to the extent possible".

This project commits to {name}: it finances it, requires it in design, specifications, tender documents, contracts or safeguards instruments, or makes the borrower or operator responsible for it. A named intervention counts wherever it is printed, including in a Paris Alignment, climate co-benefits or climate screening section or after a lead-in about alignment. A measure listed as what the project will do ("including", "such as") is 3 only when the listed item is itself {name}. Technical assistance is 3 only when it produces a named deliverable that is itself {name}.
